title: Research Immersion in OR and Data Analytics
description: An overview of active research areas in Operations Research and Data Analytics, and an introduction to the essential components of research studies. This course helps students develop fundamental research skills, including paper reading, problem formulation, problem-solving, scientific writing, and research presentation. Classes are in seminar format, with students analyzing research papers, developing research projects, and presenting research findings
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: IEOR E3608 AND IEOR E3658 AND IEOR E4307 ; For IEOR undergraduates only.
raw_title_text: IEOR E3700 Research Immersion in OR and Data Analytics. 3.00 points .
